blurb: 4 Sons Charters offers guided fishing trips offshore and inshore around Charleston, SC. Trips target species such as Red Snapper, pelagic fish like Mahi-Mahi and Tuna, sharks, flounder, and various species for fly fishing. They provide expert guidance, all necessary gear, and service from start to finish for anglers of all experience levels.
